description:
The Apple Cloud Engineering team is looking for an exceptional software engineer to build and integrate software to orchestrate workloads across highly performant and energy efficient systems that will power the next generation of data centers. 

In this highly collaborative role, you will be at the center of multiple efforts to utilize hardware acceleration for machine learning and high performance computing workloads. You will be part of a team that builds and maintains system software such as runtime libraries, frameworks, and daemons that will power the next generations of data centers. You will partner with teams across Apple to adapt, tailor, and scale software on a novel compute platform and will help to build the foundation of our future cloud architecture. 

We are looking for someone with proven mastery building and managing scalable, resilient systems. You should have a strong mix of education and practical experience with a real passion for diving head first into challenging problems.

Description
You will work cross-functionally with architecture, platform design and software teams to develop and integrate best in class hardware, software and services. You will be responsible for building and maintaining system infrastructure that powers next generation of data centers. You will ensure high quality and agility with unit tests, integration tests and performance tests.

You’re a Great Fit If You:
Have strong software design and programming skills.
Are passionate about developing new features, maintaining existing code, and fixing bugs.
Are a strong problem solver.
Communicate clearly and enjoy collaborating with others.

Responsibilities
Design and operate secure, privacy-preserving software releases built on Docker-like containers using OCI images, runc, and Linux namespaces.
Build tooling to manage container lifecycles across release environments.
Contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, and design documents.
Improve automation and CI/CD across the deployment pipeline.
Debug and resolve production issues in distributed cloud systems.
Work cross-functionally with architecture, platform design, and software teams to develop and integrate best-in-class hardware, software, and services.
Build and maintain the system infrastructure that powers the next generation of data centers.
Ensure quality and agility through unit, integration, and performance tests.

Minimum qualifications
4+ years of experience in software development, building and managing cloud infrastructure or distributed systems.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
Strong engineering skills in Pkl or a similar configuration language, including design, testing, debugging, code review, and long-term maintainability.
Knowledge of operating system architecture and low-level system components.
Experience with cloud orchestration engines such as Kubernetes or Nomad.
Track record of building, shipping, and operating production cloud services or infrastructure.
Experience with Linux, including systemd, cgroups, containers, socket IPC, and, creating, running, and debugging user-space processes using tools such as eBPF.
Clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with Swift, Objective-C, and Apple development tools.
Familiarity with OCI image and runtime specs, runc, Linux namespaces, cgroups, and overlay filesystems.
